meta_description:
4,331 likes, 89 comments - anoushkalila on October 7, 2026: "There is no such thing as a quiet hour in Prague. Even at the crack of dawn Charles Bridge is a hive of activity, and the crowds at the Astronomical Clock converge long before the first morning coffee is drunk. Our usual preference for empty shots was a non-starter, and we ended up with all sorts of random slivers of footage with no cohesive tone or story.

Whilst I love editing photographs, I’ll admit I find video a chore. So I decided to try and mix it up with this one, and have a bit of fun with it. It’s a bit scrappy, but I’ve tried to convey some of the essence of the city. The imposing statues and sculptures of Prague Castle’s grand St. Vitus Cathedral. An analogue photo booth in an unassuming shopping complex hidden in a backstreet. And the trams that make traversing the city oh so aesthetic.

I guess this is a bit of a love letter to Prague, a city I hate to shoot but love to explore. I have lots more practical tips and recommendations for this city coming soon too, so follow along if you’re planning a trip.".
